messages:
deploy-bot: Started rollout: hotflip/v2 -> prod (strategy=RollingUpdate) https://deploys.internal/1728123456
sumeet: seeing a few pods CrashLoopBackOff in encoders-prod-*. logs show OOMKilled in init container
andrea: paging oncall: @tara oncall? :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PAGER: @tara - oncall incident triggered (S2) — check /alerts/hotflip-oom
tara: on it. what's the impact? I can't exec into pods (OOMs)
mike: HPA scaled encoders from 2 -> 8 in 3m, nodes hit allocatable, kubelet started evicting pods
sumeet: logs: init container requests 64Mi, limit 32Mi in image-entrypoint init, leads to immediate OOM on startup
tova: can we kill traffic to v2 with the FF? ff.hotflip=false
andrea: temp stop: flipping feature flag now -> `ffctl set hotflip false` :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: traffic split updated: 100% -> v1, v2 receive 0%
tara: traffic dropped, but crashlooped v2 pods still causing node pressure via restarts
mike: suggest cordon overloaded nodes and drain gracefully to avoid further evictions
sumeet: I'm preparing a small manifest patch to fix init container memory fields
andrea: rollback option: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/encoder-hotflip --to-revision=23` — recommend if fix takes >15m
tara: doing rollback now
(andrea pasted)
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/encoder-hotflip --namespace=prod --to-revision=23
kubectl get pods -w -l app=encoder-hotflip
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started
eng-sre-bot: detected new surge of 500s during rollout window, linking graph: https://telemetry.internal/graphs/encoders/5xx-spike
mike: cordoning node ip-10-0-23-17 and draining evicted pods: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-23-17 && kubectl drain ip-10-0-23-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
tara: rollback completed — controllers show desired=replicas=4, available=4
sumeet: patched manifest applied on branch hotfix/encoder-init-mem
andrea: open incident INC-2026-042 - severity S2, summary attached. customer impact: short 12m window of ~18% 5xx for inference endpoint, P95 latency up ~220ms
tova: customers with long-running streams saw resets, support ticket volume increased briefly
tara: handing off to eng-sre for postmortem and follow-up. assigning to @mike, @sumeet
mike: ack - will gather logs, kube events, and correlate with autoscaler events. ETA 45m :hourglass:
andrea: notes: root cause appears to be a bad manifest change (init container memory requests/limits inverted) + HPA reaction, then node pressure + evictions. mitigation sequence: FF flip -> rollback -> cordon/drain -> manifest patch
tara: adding runbook checklist to INC-2026-042 and scheduling postmortem meeting
sumeet: follow-up action: add CI manifest lint step to validate request<=limit for init containers
andrea: :thumbsup:
eng-sre-bot: oncall handoff to eng-sre channel at 1728123720
mike: leaving a short timeline in the ticket and linking PR hotfix/encoder-init-mem
